cues.text: A fifty-year-old man has heartburn and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease.
He is due to have an oesophagogastroduodenoscopy, a camera passed through the mouth.
During the scope, distances are measured from the incisors, the front teeth.
The normal gastro-oesophageal junction is found forty centimetres from the incisors.
So remember the number: forty centimetres from the incisors to the normal gastro-oesophageal junction.
